g.text: Every alternative, scored against the 3D print farm baseline

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Cells show each option's standing on the three axes relative to the print farm (boxed, all zero). Blue beats it; red trails it.

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #d03b3b
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #898781
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #2a78d6
font-style: italic; font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: *Micro-SaaS wage is ~$0/hr in year 1 but decouples from hours with a heavy right-tail (verified exits 3.9–6.1×). No option is all-blue — the three axes trade off;

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: the print-farm row is the only one that is never blue.
